changeSet.author: Brian Quinlivan
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Company' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'LifecycleEndDate') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Company] ADD LifecycleEndDate DATETIME NULL; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Company' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'LifecycleEndDate') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Company] DROP Column LifecycleEndDate; END
